title: Chapter 1078
text:
To encounter a clue as soon as he entered a secondary dimension, his luck was really something else. Ames' [Favored of the Stars] aura was probably shining brightly. Could it be that the Goddess of Luck had changed her sexual orientation?

Speaking of which, taking advantage of Fu Ding's luck was called touching Ames's luck. What should it be called …

Could it be called Coiling Dragon?

Since he was lucky enough to encounter the clue that Hella was looking for, Han Xiao had no reason to let it go. He asked, "Do you remember what secondary dimension it is?"

Kirkmond thought for a while before nodding. "I have some impression of it. Many people seem to know about that secondary dimension. It was quite famous during a certain period of time and had been sealed by some kind of power. Occasionally, it would emit a strong vitality that could stimulate the potential of various creatures. "Later, the seal of that dimension was lifted on its own. Many curious secondary dimension life forms went to explore it, only to find that it was dead silent and empty. The entire space seemed to lack energy to maintain itself and began to decay and shrink. In recent years, that secondary dimension showed signs of collapse and could completely disappear at any time."

Hearing this, Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

Most secondary dimensions did not exist forever and would collapse and disappear, just like withered fruits and leaves. The world of secondary dimensions was chaotic and chaotic, and new secondary dimensions were often born. Most of them were as short as bubbles, and only a small number of them could last for a long time.

Advanced civilizations and high-level mages would occasionally create artificial secondary dimensions. However, such artificial secondary dimensions were very different from naturally existing super-large stable dimensions like the Void Dimension.

There were several possibilities for a secondary dimension being sealed, and the most likely one was that the secondary dimension was a creation of some kind of powerful life form. For example, the Dimension Factories of some high-level mechanics were subsidiary dimensions that were sealed to the outside world and could not be easily entered.

"If this secondary dimension is a subsidiary dimension of a Beyond Grade A, then the reason for its decline should be the death of the Beyond Grade A who created it, causing the dimension to lose its energy supply and gradually collapse," Han Xiao guessed.

"I'm not sure." Kirkmond threw the resurrection token back to Han Xiao. "I call that place the Land of Silence. If you want to go, I can give you the coordinates of the dimension anchor point."

"Sorry to trouble you. I'm interested in that place," Han Xiao said with a smile.

Kirkmond didn't think much of it. He casually formed a ball of Void Energy and recorded the information about the Land of Dead Silence. He tossed it to Han Xiao and added, "That's right.

"The spatial walls of that dimension are already riddled with holes, with countless spatial turbulences raging within. The plane could collapse and disappear at any time. Be careful. If you are swept away by the spatial turbulence, you might get lost in the endless secondary dimensions."

Han Xiao took the ball of energy and read the information within. He then stood up and nodded. "Alright, I'll take my leave first."

This was an unexpected gain of this trip. He planned to go there after finishing his business and help Hella scout the way.

"I'll wait for you to return before starting the war." Kirkmond nodded.

After reaching an employment agreement, Han Xiao did not delay any further. He once again attached himself to the Mysterious Energy Host's body.

"Let's go. Lead the way to your old friend."

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy received the order and teleported again, disappearing with Han Xiao and Ames.

…

On the other side, Law and Fay's small fleet was slowly cruising through a vast expanse of white secondary dimensions.

On the command deck of the main ship, the virtual map of the secondary dimensions was suspended in midair. Its appearance was completely different from the detailed 3D star map of the main universe. It was like a model of countless bubbles, very much like a grape. Each bubble represented a recorded secondary dimension.

Because new secondary dimensions were often born, the terrain of the secondary dimensions was constantly changing. The map could only be used as a reference, and the coordinates of the anchor points of the different dimensions were the guides.

Law and Fay stood on the left and right side of the secondary dimension map model, silently observing. At this moment, a red dot suddenly lit up inside one of the bubbles, and a circle of red ripples appeared in the model.

"The interdimensional detection radar has found the target. The target is a peak Beyond Grade A!"

"The target is thirteen secondary dimensions away from us … Route simulation complete. We are expected to meet the target after eight jumps."

"Your Excellencies, please give your orders."

Listening to his subordinate's report, Law nodded and said with a deep voice, "Lock onto the anchor point and begin the dimension jump!"

As the order was given, these few battleships immediately activated their secondary dimension engines, turning into a few streams of light and accelerating crazily. The secondary dimension jump equipment on the ships began to operate, vibrating the space wall at a special frequency.

The moment their speed reached its peak, a gap appeared in the space wall in front of them, and on the other side of the gap was the scene of the next dimension.

The few spaceships flew straight in, and the people in the spaceships all heard a crisp 'pop', as if the space outside had caused the air inside the spaceship to vibrate.

Their vision blurred, and they had already arrived in another secondary dimension. The next second, the space wall behind them closed up and disappeared without a trace.

This was the normal way to move between secondary dimensions. The scene of the secondary dimensions changed rapidly outside the porthole. This small fleet jumped many times before finally stopping.

Rapid jumps put an extremely high load on the vehicles. Every time they passed through the space wall, they would have to endure the tearing of the space turbulence. At this time, the few spaceships were shrouded in violent space energy, and the surrounding environment was slightly distorted as if they were overloaded and boiling.

On the secondary dimension map, the fleet was finally in the same bubble as the target red dot, and the distance between them was rapidly closing.

Seeing this, Law quickly walked to the front porthole, looked in the direction where the red dot was moving, and shouted, "Prepare for battle. Prepare the Dimensional Exile Bullets."

The two of them stared out of the window, and finally, a figure rapidly approached.

Just as they were about to give the order, Law suddenly saw the appearance of this figure and quickly changed his words.

"Wait, don't fire! This person doesn't look like Black Star. His aura is different from the information. "

Clottey was wearing a mechanical suit that covered his appearance, but he did not hide his energy fluctuations.

The energy attributes of Espers and Mechanics were completely different. Experiencing it at close range, he discovered a significant difference in energy fluctuations.

Clottey sensed this group of people from afar, slowed down, stopped in front of the fleet, opened the wide-area communication, and said coldly, "Who are you?

"Who are you? Why are you stopping me?"

"We're just a secondary dimension exploration team. We're not here to stop you. We just happened to meet you," Law replied.

Clottey observed the space distortion caused by the fleet's rapid jump and knew that this group of people was lying. However, he did not expose them and asked, "What organization does this exploration team belong to?"

"We're just a civilian organization that wants to come to the secondary dimension to collect some specialties. Speaking of which, since you're able to travel through the secondary dimension alone, you must be a famous Beyond Grade A. May I have the honor of knowing your name? "Law lowered his posture.

"I'm just an ordinary Beyond Grade A," Clottey said calmly.

Law cursed in his heart.

Pfft!

You're a peak Beyond Grade A, yet you're still pretending!

Law and Fay secretly felt a headache. They were also Beyond Grade As. If not for the detection radar reflecting the other party's combat strength, the two of them would not have lowered their posture so much.

The life form cross-dimensional detection radar was a large piece of equipment that was specially used in the secondary dimension world. However, it was not accurate enough. The search conditions were already harsh enough, but the two of them did not expect their luck to be so bad as to meet another peak Beyond Grade A of unknown origin.

The two of them still did not know Clottey's identity and did not want to cause any trouble. Thus, they were not willing to use force and only wanted to leave as soon as possible.

"Your Excellency Beyond Grade A, if we have accidentally offended you and caused you to misunderstand, we apologize. If there's nothing else, we'll take our leave first."

As he spoke, he did not wait for Clottey's reply and hurriedly ordered the fleet to turn around and leave.

Looking back, the two of them realized that Clottey did not chase after them. Instead, he stayed where he was and watched them leave.

"It seems like he doesn't intend to attack us." Law heaved a sigh of relief.

"He's probably not interested in us." Fay also secretly rejoiced.

"Let's leave this secondary dimension quickly." Law turned around and ordered the crew. "Mark this target and don't bump into him again. Adjust the cross-dimensional detection radar and look for the second peak Beyond Grade A signal."

The two of them were not interested in Clottey's identity at all. The secondary dimensions were filled with crouching tigers and hidden dragons. The two of them did not want to cause any trouble and prioritized the mission.

On the other side, Clottey watched the fleet leave and did not chase after them.

There were many organizations from the main universe hiding in the secondary dimensions. They operated in secret and hid here, trying to avoid the three Universal Civilizations' rule. In the eyes of the three Universal Civilizations, they were a bunch of rats.

In Clottey's opinion, this group of people was most likely one of these organizations. They had found the wrong prey and accidentally bumped into him.

His target this time was Traveler. Since this group of people was so tactful, he could not be bothered to cause trouble.

Looking in the direction the fleet left, Clottey moved in another direction, jumping continuously.

Not long after, Clottey arrived at his destination and stepped into the secondary dimension of Evil Convergence.

As far as the eye could see, all he could see was the wriggling corrosive purple-green energy. It was like layers of wrinkled stomach walls that constantly set off tsunami-like waves. The purple-green bubbles bubbled like overflowing gastric juices, as if he was in the stomach of some strange creature.

Just as Clottey was observing his surroundings, one of the inner walls of Evil Convergence squeezed out the upper body of a man covered in purple-green mucus. It was Traveler.

At this time, his skin was pale, and he gave off an evil aura. He had entered a manic mode where he could not remain calm.

Traveler's lower body was swallowed up, and rings of visible energy waves were constantly spreading out. They were transmitted on the purple-green inner wall and absorbed by Evil Convergence.

Clottey frowned slightly. With his knowledge, it was not difficult to see that Traveler was spreading his own genetic essence, merging with this secondary dimension that seemed to have a life of its own.

"Dark Emperor, Clottey, what a rare guest … I wonder why you're looking for me. Do you want to join us? I don't mind. "Traveler laughed with a hoarse voice.

Clottey was indifferent and said coldly, "You participated in the battle against the Empire's allies and committed a crime. I'm your judge."

"So, you're here to kill me?" Traveler's lips curled up into a playful smile.

At this time, countless figures appeared on the inner wall of Evil Convergence, forming an endless army.

Most of them were dangerous creatures from different Void Dimensions, and three of them gave off Beyond Grade A auras. They were all helpers called over by Traveler.

After divining that a strong enemy was coming, Traveler used his connections in the secondary dimension to set up an ambush.

"This is the Dark Emperor of the main universe?" At this time, a Beyond Grade A who came to help said casually, "So careless. He doesn't seem like much."

Another Beyond Grade A looked down at Traveler and said with a deep voice, "Remember our agreement. This time, we're only helping you expel the strong enemy. We're not responsible for killing the Dark Emperor. Otherwise, the Red Empire will definitely hunt me down like crazy."

Hearing this, Clottey glanced at these three Beyond Grade As. They were all unfamiliar Supers that he had never seen before.

The three Universal Civilizations could not monitor the birth of every Beyond Grade A. There would always be some who were unwilling to be recorded by the three Universal Civilizations. As long as they hid their identity and strength, did not form an organization, and did not do anything, the three Universal Civilizations would not know of their existence.

Quite a number of them hid in the secondary dimensions and never appeared in the main universe.

Among them, there were neutrals who were worried about being persecuted, and there were also secret forces belonging to other advanced civilizations. For example, after the Supercluster civilizations went through the Tragedy of the Pinnacles, they did not dare show too many Beyond Grade As on the surface, so they sent some of their secret allies into the secondary dimensions to hide, not letting the three Universal Civilizations know of their existence.

At this time, Traveler opened his arms, looked up at Clottey, and laughed wildly.

"Hahaha, Dark Emperor, you do have amazing strength in the main universe, but this is my home ground. You want to kill me? Can you do it?"

Clottey's expression was calm, and a deep black light flashed in his eyes.

He raised his arms slightly, and dark energy gathered around him as he slowly opened his mouth.

He slowly said, "If that's the case, I'll have no choice but to destroy you along with your home ground."

…

Han Xiao and Ames followed the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and traveled through the secondary dimensions one after another, seeing all kinds of strange sights. After a long time, the two of them finally stopped traveling.

"We're here. This is the nest of the Holy Light Particle." The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy sounded excited.

Han Xiao looked around and saw that this was a dazzling world. There was a boundless land, mountains, forests, and rivers. However, what made up all of this was colorful, materialized light.

The towering mountain peaks were like pieces of resplendent giant gemstones. The river was flowing with a liquid light that was as thick as milk. Every leaf was like a mirror, reflecting colorful light. Everything was so pure and flawless, like a kingdom of light, like a dream in a fairy tale.

"It's pretty. This is my first time in this secondary dimension." Ames could not help but rub her eyes and helplessly say, "It's just a little painful for my eyes."

"It's a little dazzling." Han Xiao grinned and looked away. "How do we find it?"

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy laughed. "Hehe, it's either asleep or deliberately hiding. Leave it to me. It's very sensitive to my energy. As long as it comes into contact with me, it'll go crazy. So, as long as I release my aura, I'll be able to trigger its natural reaction and make it come out on its own."

Hearing this, Han Xiao could not help but glance at the Mysterious Energy Host strangely.

This is too weird. It sounds like you've trained it before …
